criteria.notes: Local weather: place, current temperature and condition, wind, humidity, visibility, sunrise and sunset, plus a multi-day outlook strip.
Photographic weather-window concept retained: a location photograph as the field with typographic data laid over it.
Reads as an editorial weather window rather than a widget; serif place name over photography with asymmetric rules is concept-specific.
Place name and current temperature dominate; the detail column and outlook labels sit at their intended roles above the floors.
Data holds contrast against the darkened photograph across the default, stale and unavailable states.
Long-condition and long-location scenarios wrap onto multiple lines and keep the full string without ellipsis.

Header, current block, detail column and outlook strip divide the surface at every aspect. The short-forecast scenario stretches a single card across the full strip with its content pinned to both edges, which is sparse but truthful to a one-day outlook and loses no data; the unavailable state substitutes an explicit message.
The location photograph renders with an intentional cover fit at every aspect; condition glyphs stay crisp and the missing-media scenario degrades cleanly.
Full-bleed photographic typography is distinct from the panelled and card-based examples.
